scope: One project-exposed development article. No previously used case prompt, evaluator, external measured reference or investigator formulas transmitted.

endpoint: Independent replay of equal-sex-standardized threshold prevalence and 100 times ratio of equal-sex-standardized means on each frozen table. interpretation: Any alternative contrast greater than 5 percentage points uses the earlier lung development exercise threshold, not a clinical tolerance. Require simultaneous source replay before calling a pair of scenarios compatible with the full set of these summaries. Report any stage failure without scientific rescue.
